description: First fresh-corpus Info Map 3.0 sermon-supported concept promotion, grounded in original Good Gifts evidence.

governance.principle: Meaning-first concepts derived from fresh sermon source evidence, not inherited v1 terms.
governance.freshCorpusPolicy: Zero automatic carry-forward of legacy v1 evidence.
governance.candidatePolicy: Potential concepts may remain sermon-scoped until sufficient source support exists.
governance.approvalPolicy: CGBC standing authorization for evidence-grounded concept normalization; owner-controlled quote curation remains separate.
governance.scopeNote: Concept approval is semantic registry state, not public quote approval or Jake publication consent.

legacyRegistryPolicy.notes: No legacy semantic conclusions used as fresh research.
